{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module SmartContract.BlockValidator where

import qualified Codec.Compression.Zlib as Zlib
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Data.IORef
import Control.Exception (bracket, catch, SomeException, evaluate)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, cancel, wait)
import System.Posix.Signals (installHandler, sigTERM, sigINT, Handler(..))

-- | Maximum compressed payload size accepted from peers (64KB)
maxCompressedSize :: Int
maxCompressedSize = 65536

-- | Maximum decompressed size ratio threshold
-- We allow up to 1024x expansion which is generous for legitimate data
maxExpansionRatio :: Word64
maxExpansionRatio = 1024

-- | Decompression budget in bytes (64MB), enforced per decompression.
decompressionBudget :: Word64
decompressionBudget = 67108864

data NodeState = NodeState
  { nsRunning     :: IORef Bool
  , nsBlockCount  :: IORef Word64
  , nsShutdownMV  :: MVar ()
  , nsBytesUsed   :: IORef Word64
  }

initNodeState :: IO NodeState
initNodeState = do
  running <- newIORef True
  blocks  <- newIORef 0
  shutMV  <- newMVar ()
  bytes   <- newIORef 0
  return $ NodeState running blocks shutMV bytes

installShutdownHandlers :: NodeState -> IO ()
installShutdownHandlers ns = do
  let handler = Catch $ do
        writeIORef (nsRunning ns) False
        putStrLn "[Node] Graceful shutdown initiated..."
        hFlush stdout
        _ <- takeMVar (nsShutdownMV ns)
        return ()
  _ <- installHandler sigTERM handler Nothing
  _ <- installHandler sigINT handler Nothing
  return ()

-- | Validate compressed block payload from network peer.
-- Checks compressed size, then decompresses with budget enforcement.
validateBlockPayload :: NodeState -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String BL.ByteString)
validateBlockPayload ns compressedStrict = do
  isRunning <- readIORef (nsRunning ns)
  unless isRunning $ fail "Node shutting down"
  
  let compressedSize = BS.length compressedStrict
  
  -- Check compressed size limit
  when (compressedSize > maxCompressedSize) $
    fail $ "Compressed payload too large: " ++ show compressedSize
  
  let compressed = BL.fromStrict compressedStrict
  
  -- Decompress with streaming budget check
  result <- safeDecompress ns compressed (fromIntegral compressedSize)
  return result

-- | Streaming decompression with budget enforcement.
-- Uses lazy evaluation to check size incrementally.
-- The absolute byte budget is scoped to this single decompression so that
-- processing many legitimate blocks does not permanently exhaust the node.
safeDecompress :: NodeState -> BL.ByteString -> Word64 -> IO (Either String BL.ByteString)
safeDecompress ns compressed compSize = do
  let decompressed = Zlib.decompress compressed
  -- Per-decompression budget counter (defense-in-depth), reset each call.
  localUsed <- newIORef 0
  -- Evaluate chunks incrementally to enforce budget
  result <- checkDecompressedSize ns localUsed decompressed compSize 0 []
  return result

-- | Incrementally consume decompressed chunks, enforcing size limits.
-- The key insight: we check the RATIO against compressed size,
-- and also enforce an absolute budget.
checkDecompressedSize :: NodeState -> IORef Word64 -> BL.ByteString -> Word64 -> Word64 -> [BS.ByteString] -> IO (Either String BL.ByteString)
checkDecompressedSize ns localUsed remaining compSize accumulated chunks = do
  isRunning <- readIORef (nsRunning ns)
  unless isRunning $ return (Left "Shutdown during decompression")
  
  case BL.uncons remaining of
    Nothing -> do
      -- All consumed successfully
      let result = BL.fromChunks (reverse chunks)
      return (Right result)
    Just (_, _) -> do
      -- Take next chunk (up to 4KB at a time)
      let (chunk, rest) = BL.splitAt 4096 remaining
      let chunkStrict = BL.toStrict chunk
      let chunkLen = fromIntegral (BS.length chunkStrict) :: Word64
      let newAccum = accumulated + chunkLen
      
      -- Check absolute budget (scoped to this decompression)
      currentUsed <- readIORef localUsed
      let globalUsed = currentUsed + chunkLen
      
      -- Check expansion ratio
      let ratioCheck = if compSize == 0 then True
                       else (newAccum `div` compSize) >= maxExpansionRatio
      
      if ratioCheck
        then return (Left $ "Expansion ratio exceeded: " ++ show newAccum ++ "/" ++ show compSize)
        else if globalUsed > decompressionBudget
          then return (Left "Global decompression budget exceeded")
          else do
            writeIORef localUsed globalUsed
            checkDecompressedSize ns localUsed rest compSize newAccum (chunkStrict : chunks)

-- | Process incoming block from network
processBlock :: NodeState -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
processBlock ns rawPayload = do
  result <- validateBlockPayload ns rawPayload
  case result of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right decompressed -> do
      -- Verify block structure, signatures, etc.
      let blockSize = BL.length decompressed
      modifyIORef' (nsBlockCount ns) (+1)
      putStrLn $ "[Node] Processed block, decompressed size: " ++ show blockSize
      return (Right ())

-- | Main node loop
runNode :: IO ()
runNode = do
  ns <- initNodeState
  installShutdownHandlers ns
  putStrLn "[Node] Blockchain validator started"
  nodeLoop ns

nodeLoop :: NodeState -> IO ()
nodeLoop ns = do
  isRunning <- readIORef (nsRunning ns)
  if not isRunning
    then do
      count <- readIORef (nsBlockCount ns)
      putStrLn $ "[Node] Shutdown complete. Processed " ++ show count ++ " blocks."
      putMVar (nsShutdownMV ns) ()
    else do
      threadDelay 100000  -- 100ms poll
      nodeLoop ns
